Description: Progression from symptom onset to death, governed by the onset-to-death distribution, scaled by the infection fatality ratio

Name: R0
Description: Initial reproduction number before interventions, averaged across all 11 countries (95% CI: 2.4–5.6)

Name: Rt
Description: Average time-varying reproduction number across 11 countries after interventions

Name: ifr
Description: Population-averaged infection fatality ratio, adjusted for age structure and contact patterns of each country

Name: infection_to_onset
Description: Mean time from infection to onset of symptoms (incubation period), used in the infection-to-death distribution

Name: onset_to_death
Description: Mean time from onset of symptoms to death, used in the infection-to-death distribution

Name: generation_interval
Description: Mean generation time (serial interval distribution used as approximation), representing average time from infection of one person to infection of another

Name: lockdown_effect
Description: Estimated relative reduction in Rt due to lockdown intervention (95% CI: 75–87%)

Name: alpha_lockdown
Description: Country-specific effect of lockdown via partial pooling

Name: alpha_school_closure
Description: Shared effect size parameter for school closure intervention across countries

Name: alpha_public_events
Description: Shared effect size parameter for banning public events across countries

Name: alpha_self_isolation
Description: Shared effect size parameter for case-based self-isolation measures across countries

Name: alpha_social_distancing
Description: Shared effect size parameter for social distancing encouraged across countries
